citations.quote:
[name="结城理"]我现在要去的，是你们两位就读过的学校吗？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]是啊哈哈，还挺巧的，没想到和吉阿达小姐还是校友……完全想象不出吉阿达小姐穿我们学校校服的样子嘛。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="吉阿达"]确实没怎么穿过，我是便服上学派。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]咦，我们学校可以这样……？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#12$1",focus="l")]
[name="吉阿达"]你真的和我读过同一所学校？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#10$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]真的呀真的呀，圣马尔索区的小孩基本都是读这间学校吧？我小时候就住这里啊。
[name="裘里奥"]圣马尔索区的主路经常有安魂教堂的仪柩车经过，坐在路边看，修士和家属的心情就会像风一样一阵一阵地拂过来……对不对？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#11$1",focus="l")]
[name="吉阿达"]好像是这样……以前大家要在城市停驻时去安魂教堂办葬礼……
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#11$1",focus="n")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_sp_ballista", volume=0.4)]
[PlaySound(key="$grenade_explosion", volume=0.4)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4217_makoto_1#3$4",focus="m")]
[name="结城理"]什么声音？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#11$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]爆炸啊。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#3$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]是圣罗可街吧，那边新开了一家泡芙店，人气很旺哦。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_bulletbarrage", volume=0.4)]
[Delay(time=4)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4217_makoto_1#13$4",focus="m")]
[name="结城理"]……你好冷静。而且刚才的声音又是……是枪声吗？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#3$1",focus="l")]
[name="吉阿达"]对，快到学校了。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4217_makoto_1#13$4",focus="m")]
[name="结城理"]……？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#10$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]那边的学生，应该是来接你的吧。
